EC1: 1. Patients over the age of 85 years except at the discretion of the Investigator and with agreement of the Sponsor.
EC3: 3. Diagnosis of chronic myelogenous leukemia (CML) in blast crisis
EC4: 4. AML in relapse [OR] or refractory after 3 or more previous lines of chemotherapy (and/or HSCT) treatment
EC5: 5. AML [OR] or antecedent MDS secondary to prior chemotherapy
EC6: 6. Persistent clinically significant non-hematological toxicity that is Grade >1 by NCI CTCAE v4 from prior chemotherapy
EC7: 7. Patients who have had HSCT and are within 100 days of transplant [OR] and/or are still taking immunosuppressive drugs [OR] and/or have clinically significant graft-versus-host disease requiring treatment [OR] and/or have >Grade 1 persistent non hematological toxicity related to the transplant
EC8: 8. Clinically active central nervous system (CNS) leukemia. Patients with CNS leukemia, which is controlled, but who are still receiving IT therapy at study entry may be considered eligible and continue receive IT therapy at the discretion of the Investigator and with agreement of the Sponsor.
EC9: 9. Patients who have previously received AC220
EC10: 10. Disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC) (diagnosis by laboratory or clinical assessment)
EC11: 11. Major surgery within 4 weeks prior to enrollment in the study
EC12: 12. Radiation therapy within 4 weeks prior to, or concurrent with study
EC13: 13. Use of concomitant drugs that prolong QT/QTc interval [OR] and/or are CYP3A4 inhibitors are prohibited [NOT] with the exception of antibiotics [OR], antifungals [OR], and other antimicrobials that are used as standard of care to prevent or treat infections and other such drugs that are considered absolutely essential for the care of the patient.
EC15: 15. Women who are pregnant [OR], lactating [OR], or unwilling to use contraception [AND] if of childbearing potential
EC16: 16. Men who are unwilling to use contraception [AND] if their partners are of childbearing potential
EC19: 19. Active hepatitis  B [OR] or C [OR] or other active liver disease
EC20: 20. History of [AND] cancer, [NOT] except Stage 1 cervix or nonmelanotic skin cancer, with the possible exception of patients in complete remission
